method: Structured JSON printed in original Actions job logs, parsed after removing timestamp prefixes; runner-local report path replaced by filename. Original ZIP bytes were not downloaded or independently digest-verified. Artifact digest fields are GitHub-reported metadata only.
limitations: Exploratory shared-runner evidence, not representative production qualification.
Two comparison runs per transport, two rounds per run, 12 operations per trial, concurrency 2; no cross-platform superiority claim.
Recorded metrics are original trial summaries, not raw individual operation latencies. Synthetic internal stages exclude database/network I/O.

analysis.measure: native round median latency / mysql2 round median latency
analysis.direction: ratio < 1: NuBloxSQL lower latency; ratio > 1: mysql2 lower latency
analysis.pairing: same workload, MySQL instance and numbered round
analysis.caveat: Shared CI host, small round count and unmeasured confounders prevent definitive performance claims.
